_comment: production-shaped FOUR-branch MINIMUM selection aggregate for Issue #1738 (audit of focus/impact through MAX/MIN/IF squashes). Four RELU branches (neuron-b1..b4) feed a single MINIMUM (neuron-minm) that drives the identity output. Used to characterise multi-branch contribution attribution: with the committed observation window (see tests/issue_1738_aggregation_squash_impact_characterisation.rs) branch b1 wins 1/2 of observations, b2 and b3 win 1/4 each, and b4 is combination-dominated (wins 0). The per-branch impact must equal the empirical win fraction and the four branch impacts must sum to the aggregate's impact (conservation, no starvation/inflation). Fixtures only - no engine behaviour change. Input neurons are implicit (referenced as input-N).
